title: Stop Applying for Jobs in 2026. Use These LinkedIn & Google Hacks Instead!
description:
Job searching feels brutal, and applying endlessly isn’t working. In this video, I share job search hacks, Boolean search strategies, LinkedIn tips, and Google shortcuts that help you find real jobs, real recruiters, and real hiring managers faster.

These are step-by-step tactics I’ve used for 20 years to help job seekers cut through ghost jobs, outdated postings, and hidden hiring processes, and most people don’t know they exist.

 Watch until the end for the Google trick that reveals the exact decision-makers at any company, even when LinkedIn hides them behind premium filters.

You’ll learn:

• How to use Boolean search to find real, active job postings
• LinkedIn hacks to uncover recruiters who hire in your field
• How OR searches instantly expand job results
• How to use alumni searches strategically
• A one-click company research hack that makes you stand out in interviews

 Subscribe @kirchnercareers for practical career advice, job search strategies, and networking tips that make things easier, not more awkward.
